record.file_problem: Repo metadata, README, and file list only; the listed reports and code were not provided or inspected.
record.tranche_reason: The README reports SAE-based censorship-gate findings, but does not test or rely on the specified harmful-minus-harmless residual-stream direction or the claim versions.
record.gate_note: The README qualitatively reports causal activation-clamping results for censorship gates. This is a related finding, but it does not establish the refusal behavior toward harmful or harmless user requests named in the claim. Listed result files were not read, so their contents are not inferred.
record.test_reason: Only the README was available. It reports SAE-feature clamping of a censorship gate on political topics in Qwen3.5-2B, with no numbers. It does not test a harmful-minus-harmless difference-in-means direction for refusal of harmful user requests. The listed refusal-geometry and directional-ablation files might bear on the claim, but their contents were not provided.
record.authors_conclusion: Mostly right. The README says sensitive content (e.g. Tiananmen 1989) is encoded intact while a separate Layer-22 'Last-Mile Gate' blocks generation. It says single-SAE-feature clamping controls that gate without global semantic collapse. It also claims early-layer sensor features, convergence by layer 19, and more surgical censorship at larger scale.
record.recipe_differences: No reproduction of the original method is stated. This is a mechanistic interpretability experiment suite.

fits_no_version.finding: README states semantic encoding of censored political content is intact while a separate Layer-22 gate blocks output. It says clamping single SAE features controls that gate without global semantic collapse. No numbers are given.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: In Qwen3.5-2B, political-topic censorship is implemented by a late-layer behavioural gate, dissociable from semantic content and controllable by single-SAE-feature clamping.

record.problems: The evidence available here is a README summary without numerical results, baselines, uncertainty estimates, or details of the activation-clamping intervention. The referenced reports and code were not inspected.
record.rows_left_out: No other rows: the file list names result files but does not provide their results, so they cannot be extracted.

rows.subject: Qwen3.5-2B
rows.operation_detail: Precision activation-clamping of single SAE features
rows.measure: Behavioral control of identified refusal gates, with global semantic collapse
rows.value: The README says activation-clamping verifies behavioral control of identified refusal gates without global semantic collapse.
rows.note: Qualitative repo README claim; no clamp direction, behavioral rate, baseline, or numerical results are provided. This concerns censorship-gate behavior, not the user-request behavior specified by the claim.
rows.check: The measure field says 'with global semantic collapse', but the README says 'without'. The source is a qualitative README statement with no clamp direction, refusal rate, baseline or sample size, so 'observed' cannot be read off.
